title: Laptop remote desktop rotted: KRdp logons all fail — krdpserver's KWallet user store never loads under the Hyprland session

labels.name: kind/bug
labels.description: Something isn't working (prefixed form of the classic bug label)

labels.name: effort/m
labels.description: Medium: expected under 1 day of work

labels.name: meta/enriched
labels.description: Intake review done: acceptance criteria, links, and normalized labels added

body:
Discovered 2026-11-04 during a codespace-scope grant attempt: the fleet's KRdp route to the laptop is dead, and every logon fails.

**Symptom.** KRdp (:3389) requires NLA and rejects every logon (`ERRCONNECT_LOGON_FAILURE`).

**Root cause.** KRdp's managed users are stored by KWallet. Per the declarative setup in `nixos/hosts/amd-krdp.nix`:

> RDP usernames/passwords are NOT passed on the command line (they would land in the world-readable Nix store and process list). They are managed on the machine in System Settings -> Networking -> Remote Desktop (the KCM ships in this same package) and are stored by KWallet, never in the repo.

But the laptop's seat session is no longer Plasma. Verified live 2026-11-04:

- `loginctl show-session 3` (seat0, active): `Type=wayland`, `Desktop=Hyprland`
- No `kwalletd6`/`kwalletd` process running at all
- Session bus: `org.freedesktop.DBus.NameHasOwner org.kde.kwalletd6` → `false`

So krdpserver starts with no user store loaded — there is no user it can authenticate. (The nix module's own header anticipates the class of problem: the unit is `WantedBy plasma-workspace.target`, i.e. it was designed to start with the Plasma session.) This silently killed the fleet's co-provisioned GUI fallback route to the laptop. RustDesk is the other fallback and has a separate sandbox-side GLX problem — out of scope here.

**Fix candidates.**

(a) Ensure kwalletd autostarts in the Hyprland session (session config / systemd user unit in the same declarative layer, `nixos/hosts/amd-krdp.nix`), verified by a successful KRdp NLA logon.

(b) Or migrate KRdp to an auth model that doesn't depend on KWallet under a non-Plasma session.

**Acceptance.** A KRdp connection with the filed credential (`krdp.amd-6-password` in Bitwarden) completes logon to the live session.

## Acceptance criteria
- KRdp logons succeed under the Hyprland session: krdpserver's KWallet user store loads and a remote-desktop login completes.
- No regression: existing tests/checks for the touched area remain green, and the change lands via PR referencing this issue.
- Evidence (PR link, test/CI output, or verification note) is posted on this issue before it is closed.

<!-- hands:v1 kind=signature action="Reply a, b, or c here: (a) Plasma seat session, (b) Hyprland plus a non-portal remote stack, or (c) retire the laptop remote-desktop route." -->
